explanation: is_nan() catches NaN but is not a finiteness predicate. Positive Infinity and inf exceed the threshold and are routed to HUMAN_REVIEW instead of being rejected. Negative Infinity is rejected by the nonpositive comparison; sNaN is rejected by is_nan().
